# Firefighter Gear Safety

> > Official NFPA resource dedicated to NFPA 1970 standards for firefighter protective ensembles, SCBA, PASS devices, and addressing PFAS chemical concerns in structural firefighting gear.

This site serves as the authoritative hub for information about the National Fire Protection Association's development of NFPA 1970, the comprehensive standard governing protective ensembles, self-contained breathing apparatus (SCBA), and personal alert safety systems (PASS) for structural and proximity firefighting. The site documents the standards development process, addresses PFAS chemical concerns, and provides updates on the IAFF lawsuit and related developments.

## Key Topics

- NFPA 1970 Standard
- NFPA 1971 (Protective Ensembles)
- Self-Contained Breathing Apparatus (SCBA)
- Personal Alert Safety Systems (PASS)
- PFAS Chemicals in Firefighter Gear
- Structural Firefighting Equipment
- NFPA Standards Council
- International Association of Fire Fighters (IAFF)
- Consensus-Based Standards Development
- Firefighter Protective Equipment
- Heat Stress in Firefighting
- Fire Safety Standards
- Technical Committee Process
- First Responder Safety
- Proximity Firefighting Gear
